HEROES III PERSONAL EDITION — OPEN-SOURCE NOTICES

This package does not include original Heroes of Might and Magic III commercial
assets. Import game data only from your own compatible installation.
Heroes of Might and Magic is a trademark of Ubisoft. This project is not
associated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Ubisoft.

The vcmiclient.js, vcmiclient.wasm and vcmiclient.data runtime files are unchanged
from homm3-browser v0.1.0 by mihaicristianfarcas and contributors:
https://github.com/mihaicristianfarcas/homm3-browser/releases/tag/v0.1.0
This browser port is licensed GPL-2.0-or-later. See LICENSE.txt.
Corresponding engine/browser-port source and build scripts are provided in:
source/homm3-browser-v0.1.0.tar.gz
The source includes the SDL2 browser-worker patch and build dependency versions.
ENGINE.json records runtime file sizes and SHA-256 hashes.

VCMI: Copyright (C) 2007-2025 VCMI Team, as stated in the upstream source.
See the AUTHORS and license files inside the included VCMI source for contributors.
VCMI source code is GPL-2.0-or-later. VCMI's own assets are CC-BY-SA 4.0.
https://github.com/vcmi/vcmi
https://github.com/vcmi/vcmi-assets
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
No claim is made that VCMI's license covers Ubisoft's original game assets.

Runtime dependencies are those of the unchanged upstream build, including
Emscripten, SDL2 and companion ports, Boost, oneTBB, zlib/minizip, libsquish,
FuzzyLite, and the image/font/audio libraries referenced by its build scripts.
Their authors retain their copyrights and licenses. The included source retains
upstream notices; consult its scripts/build-deps.sh and docs/building.md for the
pinned library versions, source locations and toolchain instructions.

Launcher modifications: November 8, 2026. Distributed GPL-2.0-or-later, using the
same license as the browser port. The original castle illustration and launcher
interface in this edition were created for this package and are distributed
under that same license. Source, tests and packaging tools are provided in:
source/personal-launcher-source.zip
Changes in v3 Free Edition: remove the separate storage-service dependency;
add AES-256-GCM encrypted static game chunks; store small cloud-save parts in
free D1; move password stretching to the browser; retain private login,
revision conflict protection, portable backups and shared-device cleanup.
The project and setup scripts do not activate a paid plan or storage product.
Engine binaries and game mechanics were not modified. Original commercial
game content is not included; your own home setup supplies it once.

This package is supplied without warranty; see the full GPL terms in LICENSE.txt.

Changes in v5 Website Uploads: add website account registration, per-account
private compressed/encrypted game-file uploads in free D1, shared storage
reservations and browser cache isolation. Deliver a complete prebuilt Pages
ZIP. No local setup scripts are required by users. @noble/hashes 1.8.0 is MIT;
its license is included at source/noble-hashes-LICENSE.txt.

Changes in v6 Crown Authority (November 10, 2026): native custom resource
with town/Capitol daily income, twelve paid council edicts/decrees, seven-day
bonuses and opponent-only hero combat sanctions; optional compatibility for
Three Realms. Original game graphic references are resolved from the user's
private installed library. No Ubisoft image files are added to this package.

Changes in v6.1 Full-folder uploads (November 10, 2026): nested game resource
folders, more supported file formats and larger limits; streaming compression
and SHA-256 hashing; temporary encrypted browser upload spool; private binary
D1 storage and per-file metadata. Existing base64 libraries remain readable.
Browser SHA-256 uses @noble/hashes 1.8.0 (MIT), with the complete license in
source/noble-hashes-LICENSE.txt. Accounts, saves and engine binaries are retained.

Changes in v6.1.1 Launcher reliability (November 10, 2026): handle missing
keyboard keys and IME input, preserve browser shortcuts, contain worker and
network response failures, check browser capabilities, and serialize library
removal/restoration with the game-tab lock. Add Chromium account/upload/save
regressions with synthetic files and a simulated engine entry point.

Changes in v6.2 Batched uploads (November 10, 2026): bounded summary/metadata
requests, bulk SQL inserts, native checksum verification, 64 KiB upload parts,
idempotent retries and paged private file-list reads. Preserve existing binary
and base64 libraries, accounts and saves. Report provider status and upload
step without rendering provider HTML. Add full-folder/retry/quota regressions.
